sections.title: What is supposed to be inherited

items.q: What is Rechavi's IKEA picture of a cell?
items.a: Every cell holds the **same catalog** (DNA). A room pulls **one page** (RNA) and builds **the chair** (protein). Less than **2%** of the genome is messenger RNA. Most other RNAs regulate genes instead of encoding furniture.

items.q: Why don't gym muscles or architecture knowledge go to your kids?
items.a: The **Weismann barrier**: only sperm and egg build the next body. Soma stays in this life. Then **epigenetic reprogramming** wipes about **90%** of chemical marks so the next embryo gets a clean book, not last year's pencil notes.

items.q: What did Fire and Mello show that later won a Nobel Prize?
items.a: **Double-stranded RNA** matching a gene makes small RNAs that **destroy that gene's mRNA**. In C. elegans the silencing **spreads** — inject or feed — into **germ cells and the next generation**. Daily worm method; origin story is antiviral defense.

items.q: How did Rechavi show inherited antiviral protection is real?
items.a: Infect parents with a **fluorescent virus** (green = replication). Disable the kids' genes for **making** small RNAs. The kids stay **black** and carry **virus-matching RNAs** only if the parents were infected. Settled in worms; **not shown in humans**.

items.q: Can a worm brain write the next generations without talking to them?
items.a: 2019 *Cell*: change **endogenous small RNAs only in the brain** and descendants **find food differently for three generations**. The RNA-carrier protein is required. That is brain → germ, not a translated synapse map back into a new brain.

items.q: If this channel exists in people, what would you do first?
items.a: **Look at the RNA.** Couples already screen DNA; nobody screens heritable RNA at IVF. RNA is plastic — rodent **exercise can correct** overfeeding inheritance. Editing dish RNAs is science fiction. The human mechanism is **unknown**.
